sentences.en: Why are so many of his movies about doomsday scenarios?
sentences.zh: 为什么他的许多电影都是关于世界末日的情景？

sentences.en: In the best-case scenario, life is just a sea of troubles.
sentences.zh: 在最好的情况下，生活也只是一片麻烦的海洋。

sentences.en: He plans to integrate real-world scenarios into his lessons.
sentences.zh: 他计划将真实世界的场景融入到课程中。
